title: Minimum Window Substring
statement:
Given strings T and P, find the minimum length window (contiguous substring) in T that contains all characters of P (including duplicates).

Print the minimum length. If no such window exists, print -1.
inputFormat:
The first line contains T.
The second line contains P.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the minimum window, or -1 if none exists.
constraints:
1 <= |T| <= 10^5
1 <= |P| <= 10^5
|P| <= |T|
T and P contain only lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: The minimum window is 'banc' (length 4) which contains a, b, c.
The window must contain 2 'a's; minimum window is 'aa'.
